description: Conservative retention rules for local generated artifacts. Rules are evaluated from top to bottom. Unknown files always require manual review.

categories.keep: Retain locally because the artifact is part of the compact reviewed evaluation snapshot.
categories.archive: Preserve only as historical context. Move to external or explicit archive storage after review.
categories.delete: Regenerable, temporary, or obsolete local artifact. Safe deletion candidate after explicit approval.
categories.manual_review: No automatic action. Inspect before deciding whether to retain, archive, or delete.
